column3: Sales reached a new high this month thanks to our marketing team. (多虧我們的行銷團隊，這個月的銷售額達到了新高。)
All employees had to evacuate the office during the fire drill yesterday. (昨天消防演習期間，所有員工都必須撤離辦公室。)
Good news spreads fast in a small office like ours. (在我們這種小型辦公室裡，好消息傳播得特別快。)
Heavy snow disrupted train services across the city this morning. (今天早上的大雪擾亂了全城的火車營運。)
The manager acted quickly to contain the problem before clients noticed. (經理迅速採取行動遏制問題，以免客戶察覺。)
Lisa will succeed Mr. Green as the department manager next month. (麗莎下個月將接替格林先生成為部門經理。)
The new proposal received strong support from our team members. (這項新提案得到了我們團隊成員的全力支持。)
Our basketball team defeated the champion in the final game yesterday. (我們的籃球隊在昨天的決賽中擊敗了冠軍隊。)
The company launched a new phone to compete with its main rival. (該公司推出了一款新手機，以與其主要對手競爭。)
The lawyer spent several days preparing documents for the court trial. (律師花了幾天時間為法庭審判準備文件。)
The judge ruled in favor of the customer after the hearing. (聽證會結束後，法官做出了對顧客有利的裁決。)

column2: adj. 被指控的、聲稱的（尚未證實）
column3: Police are looking into the alleged theft at the jewelry store. (警方正在調查那起涉嫌發生在珠寶店的竊案。)
The IT team will deploy the new software update this weekend. (資訊團隊將於本週末部署並啟用新的軟體更新。)

column2: adj. 懷疑的、持保留態度的
column3: My boss was skeptical about the idea until she saw the numbers. (我老闆在看到數據之前，對這個點子一直抱持懷疑態度。)
We need to create a simple plan for the project by Friday. (我們必須在星期五之前為這個專案制定一個簡單的計畫。)
Several customers raised concerns about the high shipping costs. (幾位顧客對昂貴的運費提出了疑慮。)
The technician repaired our office air conditioner in less than an hour. (技師不到一個小時就修好了我們辦公室的冷氣。)
He denied taking the missing laptop from the conference room. (他否認從會議室拿走了那台失蹤的筆記型電腦。)
Taking responsibility for your own mistakes is very important at work. (在工作上，為自己的錯誤承擔責任非常重要。)
